Description
The Pamp Suisse 2.5 Gram Gold Bar Lady Fortuna is one of the most popular
gold bars
in the world. The Gram Gold Bar is one of the series of beloved Lady Fortuna designs produced by the world’s leading precious metal refiner,
PAMP Suisse
which is among the investors due to its excellent design and craftsmanship.
The Fortuna Series is the most popular series produced by the PAMP Suisse in Switzerland, Ticino, 1977 and is the first gold bar series to enter the precious metals market with an artistic design in the front of each bar. PAMP Suisse’s gold bullion products are stylish and popular, as seen by the design on the front of the bar. The size of Gram gold bars provides it a simple option to invest in gold bullion at a lower price point.
The Pamp Suisse 2.5 Gram Gold Bar Lady Fortuna contains 2.5 grams of gold of purity .9999. Each of these Gold Bars is individually serialized and comes with its own assay card that guarantees the authenticity and purity of the gold bar.
The Lady Fortuna 2.5 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar incorporates exclusive
Veriscan® Technology
, which uses the metal’s tiny topography, akin to a fingerprint, to identify any registered product, assisting in the detection of counterfeit gold bars on the market. During the manufacture of these Lady Fortuna gold bars, each bar is scanned, and when scanned by clients, it is further validated by the
Veriscan® database.
Design of Pamp Suisse 2.5 Gram Gold Bar Lady Fortuna
The PAMP Suisse gold bars are known for their exquisite design. The obverse of the Pamp Suisse gram gold bars features a Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna, a fictional character representing luck and fortune. Lady Fortuna is depicted blindfolded with the hand holding the pile of gold coins overflowing from the Cornucopia. This illustrates how good fortune can turn negative at any time.
The reverse of the PAMP Suisse Gold bars features the depiction of the PAMP emblem which features the words “PAMP” enclosed inside a four small circle followed by the word Sussie just beneath it. The inscriptions that state the weight, purity, metal composition, and unique serial number can also be found on the reverse of the Gold Bar. The term “
ESSAYEUR FONDEUR” is inscribed on the back of the gold bars to guarantee the authenticity of the gold bars.
Main Highlights of Pamp Suisse 2.5 gram gold bar – Lady Fortuna
Contains 2.5 grams (
0.08038 oz
) of .9999 fine Gold.
Produced by the PAMP Sussie
Multiples of 25 are usually packaged in sealed boxes.
To ensure its legality, each gold bar comes with its own assay card.
Features the Veriscan Technology which provides extra security and authenticity by Veriscan Database to the gold bars.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
On the obverse, Lady Fortuna, the Roman goddess of luck and fortune, is depicted.
On the reverse is the PAMP Suisse logo, as well as the weight, purity, and serial number.
A unique serial number is assigned to each bar.
